# datahub_forms (Data Source)

**DataHub ✅ | DataHub Cloud ✅**

Returns the URNs of all DataHub forms visible to the authenticated principal.

Backed by `searchAcrossEntities` (OpenSearch). Forms created within the last few seconds may not yet appear. Feed the `urns` output into an `import {}` for-each block to bulk-import existing forms.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "datahub_forms" "all" {}

output "form_urns" {
  description = "URNs of all DataHub forms."
  value       = data.datahub_forms.all.urns
}

# Bulk-import every existing form into Terraform state (Terraform >= 1.11):
#
# import {
#   for_each = toset(data.datahub_forms.all.urns)
#   to       = datahub_form.imported[each.key]
#   id       = each.key
# }
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `urns` (List of String) List of form URNs (e.g. `["urn:li:form:<id>"]`).
